newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Noyabrskneftegaz share issue no earlier than 1998.
newsitem.headline: Noyabrskneftegaz share issue no earlier than 1998.

text.p: Russian oil producer Noyabrskneftegaz will not issue new shares in conjunction with re-evaluation of charter capital before 1998, holding company Sibneft, which controls the producer, said on Thursday.

"It will happen no earlier than 1998," said Sibneft spokesman Igor Khazanov who declined to specify the volume of the issue. "The board of directors will decide exactly when it happens (after the beginning of 1998), as it was given carte blanche."
The Sibneft representative said that under the company's charter, new shares issued as a result of capital re-evaluation would be distributed proportionally to current shareholders.
"In other instances, shares will be sold," he said, declining to comment under what conditions.

Noyabrskneftegaz shareholders at an annual general meeting on Tuesday authorised the issue of 115.61 billion ordinary shares and 38.54 billion preferred shares, each with a nominal value of 200 roubles.

Khazanov said the issue, which would take place no earlier than 1998, would involve a re-evaluation of capital. But he declined to say whether it would cover all the newly-authorised shares. Current charter capital is 15.71 billion roubles.
